description: Uma equipe formada por seis membros com objetivo de compartilhar conhecimento e ajudar a incluir crianças em projetos da NASA.
summary:
SUMMARY - PROJECT SUMMARY

Astro – A Small Restart is an educational and interactive game developed by the EXTRAORDINARIES team, inspired by NASA's challenge to create solutions that simulate the difficulties of space exploration and survival on other planets.

Set on Mars, the game tells the story of an astronaut who becomes separated from their crew after a storm and must survive while searching for a way to send a distress signal. To do this, the player must explore the planet, gather materials, repair the transmitter, and manage four essential resources: oxygen, food, electricity, and communication.

The project turns scientific concepts into fun challenges, encouraging logical thinking, strategic planning, and decision-making. Its importance lies in bringing children and young people closer to science and technology, showing that space exploration requires knowledge, creativity, and smart solutions to overcome real-world difficulties.
details:
PROJECT DETAILS

Astro – A Small Restart is a space survival and exploration game designed to run directly in a web browser, with no need to install any software. In the game, the player takes on the role of an astronaut left stranded alone on Mars after a storm separated them from their crew.

The mission is to survive, explore the planet, find materials and parts, repair the transmitter, and send out a distress signal so the team can carry out a rescue.

During the game, players must manage four essential elements: oxygen, hunger, electricity, and the transmitter. The player needs to monitor these resources closely, as all of them are vital to keeping the astronaut alive and the base running. Players must also explore the map, gather materials, and decide how to use the available resources. Every decision can either help or hinder the completion of the mission.

One of the main benefits of the project is turning subjects related to science and space exploration into a fun experience. While playing, participants develop logical reasoning, learn how to plan, manage limited resources, and realize that certain choices must be made carefully. In addition, the game sparks curiosity about Mars and the challenges astronauts would face on a real mission.

The intended impact is to show that learning about science and technology can be engaging and fun. The project aims to give other children the opportunity to play, think, experiment with solutions, and better understand the challenges of living beyond Earth. It also seeks to encourage an interest in programming, creativity, and problem-solving.

The game was developed as a browser-based application featuring visual assets and interactive elements.

The most creative aspect of the project lies in the story of an astronaut who has to start over virtually from scratch on an unknown planet. Instead of simply presenting facts about Mars, the game places the player in situations where they must face the challenges of survival firsthand. The concept of gathering resources, recovering equipment, and restoring communication with the crew gives every stage a clear purpose within the adventure.

During development, the EXTRAORDINARIES team focused primarily on creating a game that was fun, easy to understand, and connected to the real challenges of space exploration. Special attention was given to resource balance, the role of each element in survival, and how to present these challenges without making the game overly complicated for a young audience.

With Astro – A Small Restart, the EXTRAORDINARIES team aims to show that great missions begin with small decisions and that, even in the face of adversity, creativity, knowledge, and determination can make all the difference.
